description: Computes a natal (birth) chart from the date, local clock time and place of birth: the Sun, Moon, planets, lunar node and Lilith in the signs of the tropical zodiac and in the houses, the ascendant and midheaven, house cusps (Placidus or whole sign), aspects with orbs, the phase of the Moon, the Chinese year sign and the four pillars (BaZi), and how close the ascendant, houses and signs are to changing with the hour. Without a time it gives what does not depend on the hour. The time zone and summer time of the place are applied from the IANA history. Calculations only, no interpretation; the link opens the full result on the site.

lang.description: Language of the names in the answer: pl (default) or en

later.description: For a time the clocks showed twice (put back in autumn): the second one

place.description: A town or city, e.g. "Opole", "Kraków", "London"; the first match is used (Polish places come first)

time.description: Clock time at the place of birth, HH:MM (24-hour); leave out if unknown

tz.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Warsaw (with lat and lon)

name: birth_chart
title: Birth chart
